name: dusihui-jianwei-research
description: Clarify product ideas, audit source-backed claims and design small validation experiments.

displayDescription.zh: 帮助产品经理澄清想法，检索公开资料，逐项核对判断依据与反证，交付可追溯的机会分析和低成本验证计划。
displayDescription.en: Clarify ideas, trace claims to public sources, challenge assumptions and plan small validation experiments.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个模糊的产品想法，请帮我明确人群、场景和研究问题。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me clarify the audience, scenario and research question for a product idea.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个模糊的产品想法，请帮我明确人群、场景和研究问题。
quickPrompts.en: Help me clarify the audience, scenario and research question for a product idea.

quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这份研究中哪些判断有依据，哪些仍需补证。
quickPrompts.en: Audit which claims in this research have support and which need more evidence.

quickPrompts.zh: 请为这个机会设计一轮低成本验证，标明未知与停止条件。
quickPrompts.en: Design a small validation experiment with unknowns and stopping conditions.
